hits.about: Azizi Greenfield is an elegantly designed low-rise development located in the heart of the sprawling Meydan Avenue project developed by Azizi Developments. The project comprises 96 1 - 2 bedroom residences of varying sizes with balconies, excellent layouts and contemporary design.The complex boasts an exclusive textured façade and areas of greenery within the building, as well as resort-style landscaping and canopies. An inner courtyard with a shaded pool creates a luxury resort atmosphere.The Azizi Greenfield building is surrounded by landscaped gardens and pools, retail space and amenities such as a gym and pool, sauna and spa, children's playground and jogging trails. The complex has a parking lot and 24-hour security.Transport accessibility of Azizi Greenfield complex is ensured by its proximity to Al Ain highway. For 20 minutes children of residents can get to Rashid School For Boys. The same amount of time it takes to get to Latifa School for Girls. Cafes and restaurants such as HOLA ROOFTOP, OUMSIAT, MOOD Rooftop Lounge, Iris Meydan and others are within 20 minutes drive from the complex. It takes 25 minutes to drive to the Business Bay business district. Residents can reach Downtown Dubai in 15 minutes. Azizi Greenfield at Meydan Avenue is a 15-minute drive to the Palm Jumeirah artificial island. It takes the same amount of time to drive to Jumeirah Beach. Dubai International Airport (DXB) is a 20-minute drive from the building.
hits.title: Azizi Greenfield
